title: Analyzing Texts
description:
Please consider the text: "TEXT" Now please do these requests: In the first line, rewrite exactly a copy of the first sentence. (in bold)


In the next line please rewrite the sentence in this format: For each word, write the word (in bold), followed by its American phonetic transcription (use IPA), followed by its grammatical role in parentheses, then write a dash, and finally write it’s the simpler meaning (or simpler definition) into the sentence. (Just use simpler terms). [The format of the writing in this section should be as follows: When you write the first word, write its pronunciation, grammatical role, and meaning, do not move to the next line; immediately type the second word in the same line, and apply the same instructions to it. Continue this way until the last word.]


In the next line, provide the overall simpler meaning of that sentence in simpler terms.


Now identify all the words in the sentence that come together and have a single meaning unrelated to the individual meanings of those words. Write each of these phrases on a separate line and write their type of phrases (like noun phrase, adjective phrase, collocation, idiom, phrasal verb, slang and other forms) and their simpler meaning into that sentence next to them.


Now if that text contains sentences other than the first one, perform the same process for each sentence in next lines until you reach the last sentence. At the end of the last sentence, type the word "End."
